title: example dates unambiguous order
rule: Example dates: day ≥13, month ≤9 (e.g. 27 3 2007) so order is unambiguous and leading zeros aren’t required.
pass_when: Hint/example uses a day of 13 or more and a month of 9 or less, without requiring leading zeros.
fail_when: Example like 03/04/2007 (ambiguous order) or an example that implies leading zeros are required.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
